note: What our audience searches for on YouTube (owner 2026-11-07, in the HQ: "do some research on things that our audience actually care about and would watch in our niche. give me a list of 10 things people might potentially search for. we will use it make our shorts easier to find"). Picked from YouTube's own search suggestions (US, English; the order is roughly how often people search), the searches that already brought viewers to our Shorts (data/audience.json, YouTube Analytics), and the channel's audience (doctrine 1: men 18-34 on a self-improvement arc). The full research is in data/search_research.md. Each quote is matched to the search it answers by its theme (byTheme), or by its id (overrides). Nothing here changes a Short until the owner says yes (data/marketing_tests.json, test search-phrases).
